title: Arcane mage, level 1-3
subtitle: New at 1: 1 Fireball, 2 Shoot, Alt-Z Frost Armor, Alt-X Arcane Intellect, Alt-H Hearthstone
summary: Arcane mage keys as of level 1. New: 1 Fireball, 2 Shoot, Alt-Z Frost Armor, Alt-X Arcane Intellect, Alt-H Hearthstone.
notes: Apply the step that matches your level. Spells you haven't learned yet are skipped.
Each step builds on the one before, so applying the next step over this one is safe.
Talent spells are not included. Put those on an empty key yourself.
